description_en: Accurately detects key information from travel permits, including name, date of birth, certificate number, and more. Supports Mainland Travel Permits for Hong Kong and Macao Residents as well as Mainland Travel Permits for Taiwan Residents

name: RecognizeExitEntryPermitToMainland
